remarks: Welcome Home to 205 Hope Street! This highly desirable, sunlit end unit is nestled in one of the city's prime locations. Lovingly maintained, this home features an expansive Primary Suite with a jetted tub, perfect for unwinding after a long day. The complex is conveniently located within walking distance to the train, shops, restaurants, parks, and more.  Step outside to enjoy the wonderful outdoor living space, with sliders leading to a deck right off the living area. This home offers modern comforts, including gas heating, central air conditioning, a cozy gas fireplace, and a full-size washer and dryer in its own dedicated room. The attached two-car garage ensures your vehicles are protected from the elements.  205 Hope Street is a must-see and a pleasure to show. Come and discover why this exceptional property should be your new home!
